raw_text: ALARMING: Detailed Chinese plan to invade Andaman Islands has surfaced online. PLA to use 3 amphibious assault ships with 6000 marines. J-20 fighter jets providing air cover from Hainan. Indian Navy apparently cannot respond in time. This looks like an actual operational plan that has been leaked. How does anyone have this level of detail about PLA capabilities? Very concerning.
clean_text: Telegram post presents war gaming fiction as alarming Chinese invasion plan for Andaman Islands. Strips fictional context and presents details as leaked operational plan. Questions how someone has this level of PLA capability detail.
